Terrible experience at this flashy and aggressive Walking Street bar
Jan 2024 • Friends
Agree with several poor reviews posted already. While the snack food (fries, edamame, etc) was okay - nothing to rave about, but satisfying for late night - the service was terrible…and aggressive. We sat outside to people watch and after finishing our food and two expensive drinks, we were approached by staff to ask “why you not drink?” The dancing girls were very sexy (though 100% only there for dancing - no sitting with customers to chat - and certainly no shot at bringing one back to your room) and DJ/music was good. 

They will put peanuts and wet wipes on your table but - as in some other bars / restaurants throughout Asia - will not tell you they’re not free. Luckily, being an experienced traveler, I told my group not to eat/use them unless they wished to pay for them, so we set them aside. When we asked for the bill, I noticed we’d been charged for them (equivalent of $2.25 for the small bowl of peanuts and $1 for five wet wipes). When I pointed out to the staff that we didn’t use them, they seemed quite annoyed that we’d argue over $3, but it’s on principle - we were being charged for something we shouldn’t have. But wait! — after they took those items back, the server gave us the peanuts back and silently motioned as if to say, “no problem, here, you can have the peanuts.” After eating a handful, she then charged us for them.

There are much better clubs/bars along Walking Street at which to spend your money.

Came in for a few happy hour drinks. So pricy! 80k for one beer, but BOGO during hour hour.
